notes.title: Post-Release Update Plan
notes.notes:
Several updates are planned for At the Gates and each is outlined in brief below. You can also find a copy of the full tasklist for the game [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/241000/discussions/0/1743358239834179395/]in this Steam forums thread[/url]. To report bugs or receive technical assistance we recommend visiting [url=http://forums.conifergames.com/index.php?board=23.0]the official Conifer forums[/url].


[b]v1.01[/b] ... The first major patch, mainly focused on fixing serious bugs and gameplay issues immediately after release. Target date: 1-2 weeks after release.

[b]v1.1[/b] ... The second major patch, mainly focused on fixing serious gameplay issues and improving basic UI and UX. Target date: Mid-March.

[b]v1.2[/b] ... The third major patch, mainly focused on gameplay balance, the user interface, and AI. Target date: Late May.

[b]v1.3[/b] ... The fourth major patch, mainly focused on diplomacy, the late-game, AI, and modding. Target date: Mid-September.
